title: resolve_conflict derives one handling table keyed over every THREAD_RULES path
context: Three hand-written switches plus an indexed field pattern each enumerated the spine scalars separately, and all four omitted spine.landed and artifacts. Because the tool demands a winner for every reported conflict, one unresolvable path refuses the whole batch and the sync cannot be cleared by any tool. THREAD_RULES is declared Record<..., FieldRule>, so its value types widen and TypeScript cannot filter it by rule; narrowing it would mean editing field-merge.ts, which this unit could not touch.
options: Add spine.landed and artifacts to each of the four hand-written sites and stop
Derive one handling table keyed over every THREAD_RULES path, with a runtime census asserting rule-to-handling agreement
Narrow THREAD_RULES so the table can be filtered by rule at compile time
outcome: Replaced all four enumerations with one table typed Record<keyof typeof THREAD_RULES, FieldHandling>, so a field added to the merge rule table later fails the typecheck here until it is given a handling. Rule-to-handling agreement is asserted at runtime by a closed census over the conflict-on-divergence and union-by-id entries, carrying no spine. filter - that filter is the one U3's census uses and is exactly what would have let this gap pass. Verified by mutation: reclassifying spine.landed to the no-conflict marker produced 'census halted on an unclassifiable item: spine.landed', and restoring it went green.
